sources.title: North Micro Vision - Learn AI
sources.snippet: North Micro Vision is an open-weight vision-language model developed by Cohere and released on August 12, 2026, under the Apache 2.0 license. The model combines a custom-trained four-hundred-million-parameter native-resolution vision encoder with a two-billion-parameter language backbone based on Cohere's Command A+ architecture, yielding a total of 2.4 billion parameters. sources.snippet: North Micro Vision Instruct North Micro Vision Instruct is a 2.4B-parameter open-weight vision-language model with native-resolution image support, released under the Apache 2.0 license. It is designed as a compact foundation for prototyping, task-specific fine-tuning, and specialized multimodal applications. Developed by Cohere.
